Every floor a new world.

Most floors are built in a different world, picked from those its mod made for that stage of the dungeon. There are 19 ported from Combusted, Devoted, Magic Ling and Transformation Pixel Dungeon, alongside Shattered's own five. The world sets the look and music. Your actual depth still sets monsters, loot and traps, so the game stays fair. Floor 1, the boss floors and the quest floors (4, 9, 14, 19) keep their usual world.

**Already installed version 0.2.1 or later?** Just launch the game. It updates itself.

**Windows.** Download `OnyxPixelDungeon-<version>-Windows.zip`, unzip it, and run **Play.bat**. Java is included. If SmartScreen warns you, click **More info** and then **Run anyway**.

**Smaller Windows download.** `OnyxPixelDungeon-<version>-Windows-Installer.zip` is about 16 MB. Unzip it and run **Install.bat**, which downloads the official Shattered Pixel Dungeon runtime from GitHub, sets the game up, and adds a desktop shortcut.

Both Windows downloads check for new versions each time you launch from Play.bat or the shortcut, so you only need to download once.

**Mac or Linux.** With Java 11 or newer installed, run `java -jar OnyxPixelDungeon-<version>.jar`. On a Mac, add `-XstartOnFirstThread` before `-jar`.
